paragraphs.text: Sheep is a creature type used for cards that depict a species of ruminant mammals of the genus Ovis, bred in a number of domesticated varieties for wool and meat.

Sheep appear most prominently in white followed by green . Rustspore Ram is the only colorless sheep, and the Unfinity card Baaallerina is the only blue sheep. Sheep have not appeared in black or red .

Sheep used to be a token -only creature type. Sheep tokens were introduced with Ovinomancer from Visions . This card was created as a tribute to the polymorph spell in the Blizzard computer game Warcraft , which was popular with the R&D team during the Visions design period.

Unglued featured a Sheep token with unspecified power and toughness, meant to be used with Flock of Rabid Sheep . The tokens produced by Flock of Rabid Sheep should have been Rabid-Sheep . Or Rabid should have been a separate subtype like Minor . This was never the case, and all subtypes from the Un-sets were removed from the official list in the Grand Creature Type Update, anyway. Under the present rules, they are Sheep-tokens "called Rabid Sheep".

The Sheep type first appeared on cards in the Grand Creature Type Update , when it was added to the artifact creature card Rustspore Ram from Mirrodin . Much later, Journey into Nyx added Nyx-Fleece Ram and Ravnica Allegiance added Gatebreaker Ram .
